advice_boundary: AiFA computes and organises SOCSO-relevant figures and flags obligations; it does not replace a licensed payroll/tax professional's formal advice or filing responsibility (Vol 6_9 Section 5, extended to payroll by Vol 13_0 Section 10).
source_note: Rates researched via web search against secondary 2026 Malaysian payroll-reference sources this session could reach, NOT verified against PERKESO/SOCSO's own primary published contribution table directly. Confirm against the official SOCSO Second Category contribution table before relying on this for a real payroll run. Not owner-editable in-app, per Vol 13_0 Section 10's explicit instruction.
notes: Employment Injury + Invalidity Scheme (Second Category), effective since October 2024's ceiling change. Wages above RM6,000 are contributed on RM6,000 (capped), not a graduated bracket table.
